""" Web scraper for extracting API documentation from HTML pages. This initial implementation provides basic HTML parsing functionality that will be evolved to handle complex documentation structures. The LLM will have access to actual documentation pages through optillm's readurls plugin, allowing it to understand the specific HTML structure and improve the parsing logic accordingly. """ from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from typing import Dict, List, Optional import re # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START # HYPOTHESIS-1: Extracting text from all paragraph descendants will improve completeness by capturing multi-paragraph descriptions # MECHANISM-1: Documentation often spans multiple paragraphs within a container element; aggregating all text within parent structures captures fuller descriptions # EXPECT-1: completeness > 0.38 # RESULT-1: REFUTED (actual=0.325) # HYPOTHESIS-2: Normalizing signatures for deduplication will improve accuracy by eliminating whitespace-variant duplicates # MECHANISM-2: The same function can appear with different whitespace formatting; normalizing before comparison prevents counting variants as separate functions # EXPECT-2: accuracy > 0.76 # RESULT-2: REFUTED (actual=0.7222222222222222) def scrape_api_docs(html_content: str) -> List[Dict[str, any]]: """ Extract API documentation from HTML content. Args: html_content: Raw HTML content of a documentation page Returns: List of dictionaries containing function documentation """ soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, "html.parser") seen_sigs = {} # Track by normalized signature to avoid duplicates # Method 1: dt/dd pairs (highest quality - Sphinx documentation) dt_blocks = soup.find_all("dt", class_="sig") for dt in dt_blocks: sig_name = dt.find(class_="sig-name") if sig_name: name = sig_name.get_text(strip=True) signature = dt.get_text(strip=True) norm_sig = normalize_signature(signature) # Extract description from dd sibling description = extract_description_from_element(dt.find_next_sibling("dd")) if norm_sig not in seen_sigs: seen_sigs[norm_sig] = { "name": name, "signature": signature, "description": description, "parameters": extract_parameters(signature), } # Method 2: h3/h4 headers (medium quality) for header in soup.find_all(["h3", "h4"]): text = header.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text and len(text) < 200: name = text.split("(")[0].strip() norm_sig = normalize_signature(text) if norm_sig not in seen_sigs: # Look for description in following siblings description = extract_description_from_siblings(header) seen_sigs[norm_sig] = { "name": name, "signature": text, "description": description, "parameters": extract_parameters(text), } # Method 3: code blocks (lower quality - fallback) code_blocks = soup.find_all("code") for code in code_blocks: text = code.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text and len(text) < 150: name = text.split("(")[0].strip() norm_sig = normalize_signature(text) if norm_sig not in seen_sigs and name: # Try to find description in parent structure description = extract_description_from_parent(code) seen_sigs[norm_sig] = { "name": name, "signature": text, "description": description, "parameters": extract_parameters(text), } return list(seen_sigs.values()) def normalize_signature(sig: str) -> str: """Normalize signature for deduplication by removing extra whitespace.""" return re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', sig.strip()) def extract_description_from_element(element) -> str: """Extract description text from an element and its descendants.""" if not element: return "No description found" # Get all text from paragraphs within the element paragraphs = element.find_all("p", recursive=True) if paragraphs: texts = [p.get_text(strip=True) for p in paragraphs[:3]] # First 3 paragraphs desc = " ".join(texts) if desc: return desc[:300] # Reasonable length limit # Fallback to direct text text = element.get_text(strip=True) return text[:300] if text else "No description found" def extract_description_from_siblings(element) -> str: """Extract description from sibling elements following a header.""" descriptions = [] current = element.find_next_sibling() # Collect text from next few siblings until we hit another header count = 0 while current and count < 3: if current.name in ["h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "h5", "h6"]: break if current.name in ["p", "div"]: text = current.get_text(strip=True) if text and len(text) > 10: descriptions.append(text) count += 1 current = current.find_next_sibling() if descriptions: return " ".join(descriptions)[:300] return "No description found" def extract_description_from_parent(element) -> str: """Extract description from parent structure.""" parent = element.parent if not parent: return "No description found" # Look for description in parent's text or siblings desc_elem = parent.find_next_sibling(["p", "div"]) if desc_elem: text = desc_elem.get_text(strip=True) if text: return text[:300] return "No description found" def extract_parameters(signature: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]: """ Extract parameter information from a function signature. Args: signature: Function signature string Returns: List of parameter dictionaries """ params = [] match = re.search(r"\((.*?)\)", signature) if match: param_string = match.group(1) if param_string and param_string.strip(): # Split by comma, but be careful with nested structures param_parts = [] current = "" depth = 0 for char in param_string: if char in "([{": depth += 1 elif char in ")]}": depth -= 1 elif char == "," and depth == 0: param_parts.append(current.strip()) current = "" continue current += char if current.strip(): param_parts.append(current.strip()) for part in param_parts: if not part or part in ["...", "*", "**"]: continue # Extract name, handling type hints and defaults name = part.split(":")[0].split("=")[0].strip() name = name.lstrip("*").strip() if name: type_hint = "unknown" default = None # Extract type hint if ":" in part: type_part = part.split(":")[1].split("=")[0].strip() if type_part: type_hint = type_part # Extract default value if "=" in part: default_part = part.split("=")[-1].strip() if default_part: default = default_part params.append({ "name": name, "type": type_hint, "default": default, "description": "", }) return params def format_documentation(api_docs: List[Dict[str, any]]) -> str: """ Format extracted documentation into a readable string. Args: api_docs: List of API documentation dictionaries Returns: Formatted documentation string """ output = [] for doc in api_docs: output.append(f"Function: {doc['name']}") output.append(f"Signature: {doc['signature']}") output.append(f"Description: {doc['description']}") if doc.get("parameters"): output.append("Parameters:") for param in doc["parameters"]: output.append(f" - {param['name']}: {param.get('description', 'No description')}") output.append("") # Empty line between functions return "\n".join(output) # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END # Example usage and test if __name__ == "__main__": # Sample HTML for testing basic functionality sample_html = """
json.dumps(obj, indent=2)

Serialize obj to a JSON formatted string.

json.loads(s)

Deserialize s to a Python object.

""" docs = scrape_api_docs(sample_html) print(format_documentation(docs)) print(f"\nExtracted {len(docs)} functions")
